text:
Happy is the one who sighs beside you, for you!
Who hears the echo of your ringing voice!
Who adores the charm of your laughter
and breathes the soft fragrance of your breath!


Such fortune—which the cherub in heaven
admires with envy—
troubles the soul, devours the heart,
and dies upon the clumsy tongue as it is told.


The world disappears before my eyes,
and through my veins I feel coursing lightly
the fire of profound love.


Trembling, in vain I try to resist you…
I flood my cheek with ardent tears,
I rave, rejoice, bless you, and die!

translation.title: Imitating an Ode by Sappho
